name: Quinlan Vos's lightsaber
description: Quinlan Vos constructed his green-bladed lightsaber while under the tutelage of Jedi Master Tholme. Vos wielded his lightsaber aggressively, After becoming a Jedi Knight, Vos continued to use the lightsaber, even during the Clone Wars.
